load_tfds_dataset: load a tensorflow dataset by name with tfds.load returning a tf.data.Dataset
build_tfds_builder: build a tfds DatasetBuilder instance by name with optional config and version
list_tfds_datasets: list all registered tensorflow dataset builder names with optional community datasets
load_tfds_collection: load a dataset collection by name and retrieve individual datasets from the collection
get_tfds_data_source: get a data source from a tensorflow dataset for iteration or use with a PyTorch DataLoader
